rules.rule: Largest Contentful Paint at 75th percentile: 2.5 s or less.
Interaction to Next Paint: 200 ms or less.
Cumulative Layout Shift: 0.1 or less.
First Contentful Paint: 1.8 s or less.
Time to First Byte : moins de 800 ms.
Judge on field data (RUM) at P75 by default; consult P90/P95/P99 for the tail.
Scores 0-100 in three bands: 90-100 good, 50-89 needs improvement, 0-49 poor; target band passage over 100, whose marginal cost explodes.
Complement real measurement with a lab score before production to avoid regressions; in lab, TBT replaces INP.
Aggregate measurement by dynamic route (pattern /blog/[slug]) rather than concrete URL.
Filter or expunge sensitive data from measurement events before sending (beforeSend hook); reduce sample (sampleRate) to control cost.
Serve device-resized images in modern formats (AVIF, WebP), cached after transformation; single target format often suffices.
Do not route through the optimizer sources that gain nothing from it: images under 10 KB, vectorial (SVG), animated (GIF).
Restrict the optimizer with whitelists (remote and local host and path patterns, qualities, widths) to limit variants and abuse; include account identifier in path when host is not yours.
If images change less than once per month, cache duration at least 31 days.
Quality parameter ranges 1 to 100; lowering quality reduces weight and cost.
Load only actually used families and variants (entry points separated by variant) and declare font-display swap; preserve necessary variable axes when loading.
Without explicit header, dynamic response not cached by CDN or browser (public, max-age=0, must-revalidate): all shareable content must declare its policy.

Server-rendered page identical for all: starting point max-age=0 and s-maxage of one day (CDN cache invalidated on deployment, browser always fresh); add short max-age (60-120 s) to ease repeated visits.
Pair s-maxage with stale-while-revalidate to serve stale cache during background regeneration, and stale-if-error to serve stale on origin error.
CDN cache duration between 1 s and 1 year.
no-store for any sensitive or real-time response; private for user-specific content.
Separate browser policy (Cache-Control) from CDN policy (CDN-Cache-Control, or provider-specific header) when they differ.
Avoid Vary on high-cardinality headers (Cookie notably, not cached); for per-user content, use application cache.
Static resources with hashed names served immutable with maximum duration; survive deployments.

For rarely modified content, prefer incremental static regeneration (stale-while-revalidate pattern): immediate cached response, regeneration by interval or on demand, previous content retained on failure with retry at 30 s.
Coalesce simultaneous requests on the same uncached entry to invoke origin only once.
Stream long responses (including LLM outputs) rather than wait for complete response.
